canonical_serialization: json.dumps(item_without_digest, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True) -> sha256, prefixed 'sha256:'
note: control-bench-v0.jsonl (1,000 items, ~1.3 MB) is byte-deterministic output of the generator with rng_seed 20260920 against the seed/ directory at this commit; it is regenerated on demand rather than committed. The sha256 above pins that byte output. Full per-category coverage (authentic/synthetic counts, safety-critical counts, contamination group lists) is reproduced by running the generator; see CONTROL-BENCH-V0-DESIGN.md for the frozen coverage table.
split_note: Contamination groups are assigned here; train/validation/test split assignment happens at freeze, by group, never by item.
